setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_scalar_sales AS SELECT CASE WHEN i%97=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%32 END region, CASE WHEN i%11=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%1001-500 END price, CASE WHEN i%13=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%101-50 END adjustment, CASE WHEN i%37=0 THEN NULL WHEN i%41=0 THEN 'SRID=4326;POINT EMPTY'::geometry ELSE ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint((i%1000)::float8/50,((i/1000)%1000)::float8/50),4326) END::geometry(Point,4326) geom FROM generate_series(1,2000000) s(i)
